newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: FOG CAUSES 50 CAR CZECH PILEUP - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: FOG CAUSES 50 CAR CZECH PILEUP - AGENCY.

text.p: Police blamed dense fog for a chain-reaction accident on Monday where an estimated 50 cars piled up on the D1 motorway connecting Prague to the Czech second city Brno, the CTK news agency reported on Monday.
Only three people were injured, none seriously, in the mid-morning accident in the Prague-bound lane of the D1, less than a kilometre (0.62 miles) outside of Brno, it said.
Traffic was severely limited, and cars were backed up on the most heavily-travelled Czech motorway until the Prague-bound lane was reopened at in the early afternoon.
The D1, built through a series of valleys running through the Czech-Moravian highlands, often is blanketed with thick fog, especially on warm winter days and in early spring.
The weather on Monday was unseasonably warm.
